title: ice cream storage
text: ice cream storage. I purchased these as a "suggested" purchase when I bought an ice cream maker.  Very nice quality and did a good job of storing the ice cream we made. The body is a plastic like material and the lid is silicone or like.  They say dishwasher safe, and I washed them on the top rack- no problem.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: StarPack Ice Cream Containers for Homemade Ice Cream (2 Pcs) - Reusable Ice Cream Storage Containers for Freezer - Leak-Free Ice Cream Containers with Lids (Silicone) - 1 Liter per Ice Cream Container
features: STYLISH REUSABLE ICE CREAM CONTAINERS - Each homemade ice cream container holds 1 Liter (1 Quart) and measures 5.3” tall X 4.7" Wide. A set contains 2 ice cream freezer storage containers, eliminating the need for large ice cream pint containers! Great for storing & gifting your creations!

MADE WITH DURABLE, QUALITY MATERIALS – Our homemade ice cream storage containers are BPA-free. The ice cream tub is made from polypropylene. The ice cream storage lid - durable silicone. Each storage container for ice cream is Freezer & Microwave safe!

STACKABLE & EASY TO CLEAN - These ice cream freezer containers stack together to save space when not in use. To clean the ice cream tubs for freezer, use hot water or place the ice cream container with lid detached in the dishwasher. The lids are leak-free and close tightly!

HOT OR COLD - SOUP OR CREAM – The homemade ice cream storage containers aren't just for your sweet & creamy treats! They're fantastic for soups and other meals in need of freezer-safe & fridge-safe storage! Just remember to let them cool before storing as overly hot foods can damage refrigerators.
